knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The procedure says to identify the material and any protective finish before selecting a method, and to check manufacturer or site guidance when uncertain.
The worked decision on an unlabelled polished stone counter says not to apply an acidic descaler and to seek the approved care specification.
Competent completion requires a documented decision that matches the identified surface. A clean result alone does not show the method was safe.

practicalCriteria: Learner identifies the material and finish of a supplied surface from a normal viewing position and at a low angle.
Learner tests a hidden area of an unfamiliar supplied surface and records the result before full cleaning.
Learner records the surface, finish and care guidance on the job record, and refers any surface whose material is unclear.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Job record showing surface, finish, care guidance and test result
stopWorkCriteria: Learner uses a method on a surface whose care guidance does not allow it
Learner uses steam or water on a surface not approved for it
